result.rationale: In embeddable-host.js.es6 the delete action calls this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(() => { this.sendAction('deleteHost', ...) }) with no .catch, unlike save() which does use popupAjaxError. A failed server delete produces an unhandled rejection with no user feedback and the row isn't removed, so the described mechanism is verifiable in the diff.

adjudication.rationale: In the new `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(() => { ... })` but does not attach a `.catch(popupAjaxError)` (or any rejection handler). If the DELETE request fails, the promise rejection is unhandled and the user gets no feedback, matching the finding.
